type.label: Promo: Image + Text
type.description: Image on the left, heading, text and a button on the right. Stacks on mobile.

field.name: image
field.label: Image
field.description: Shown at its own proportions: half the width on desktop, full width on mobile.

field.name: image_alt
field.label: Image alt text
field.description: What the image shows, for screen readers. Leave empty if it only decorates.

field.name: heading
field.label: Heading
field.description: A line break here is a line break on the page, e.g. "Introducing the" / "Elme Outlet".

field.name: text
field.label: Text
field.description: One to three short paragraphs. Bold for the offer.

field.name: button_label
field.label: Button label
field.description: Two or three words. Leave empty for no button.
